name: Yagihara
source:
Yagihara is the leader and main vocalist of Star Generation. He discovered d2b's ability and supports them.
[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirakira_(visual_novel)]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]In Curtain Call he became a producer of Happy Circle Mania and owned the music theater.[/spoiler]
